name: University of Twente
note: A campus university with more than 3,000 student rooms on site - which matters a lot given the national room shortage.
about: A campus university on parkland outside Enschede near the German border, and the technical university that has always mixed engineering with social science — psychology, communication and management sit alongside mechanical engineering and computer science. Almost all its bachelor programmes are taught in English, which gives it a lot to lose from the internationalisation bill.

requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you, and Twente publishes the alternative in more detail than any other Dutch institution here. Twente names IB certificates once, and only "in combination with another high school diploma", so Course Results standing alone are not directly admissible. What it publishes instead is the Colloquium Doctum (toelatingsonderzoek), which it runs under articles 7.25, 7.28 and 7.29 of the Dutch Higher Education Act. You must be at least 21 on 1 September of the year you start. Applications open on 1 October through Studielink like anybody else's: you file a normal enrolment request before the programme's deadline, then complete the Osiris questionnaire, upload whatever diplomas you do hold and a blank PDF stating that you are applying via a full Colloquium Doctum. You then have to pass the VWO-level subjects Twente lists for this programme — VWO English, VWO Mathematics B and VWO Physics — with certificates from CCVX, James Boswell or the Dutch Official State Examination, all before that programme's deadline. There is no blanket Dutch-language requirement: VWO Dutch appears in Twente's table only against its Dutch-taught programmes, and not against this one. Twente also publishes two slower routes: an hbo propedeuse, the first 60 ECTS of a bachelor at a Dutch university of applied sciences, NVAO-accredited and relevant to the programme, which it says does not guarantee admission; and a foundation year, accepted only where the resulting qualification is nationally accredited in the country it was taken in, assessed case by case. All of these wait for your 21st birthday. Retaking to be awarded the full IB Diploma is the route that reaches this at eighteen. One further route is national rather than this institution's, and it is the only one that produces the qualification itself instead of an exemption from it: the Dutch staatsexamen vwo. Anyone who registers may sit vwo subjects one at a time with DUO — registration for the 2027 examinations runs from 15 October to 31 December 2026, each subject costs 144 euro with a ceiling of 720 euro a year, and the certificates stay valid for ten years, so the package can be built up and exchanged for a vwo diploma at the end. No age limit applies, which is what makes it different from every colloquium doctum above, and Dutch law lets the College voor Toetsen en Examens grant you ontheffing from individual subjects on the strength of International Baccalaureate results — the one place in Dutch education law where the IB is named. The bill is linguistic: by statute the examinations are sat in Dutch.

requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you, and Twente publishes the alternative in more detail than any other Dutch institution here. Twente names IB certificates once, and only "in combination with another high school diploma", so Course Results standing alone are not directly admissible. What it publishes instead is the Colloquium Doctum (toelatingsonderzoek), which it runs under articles 7.25, 7.28 and 7.29 of the Dutch Higher Education Act. You must be at least 21 on 1 September of the year you start. Applications open on 1 October through Studielink like anybody else's: you file a normal enrolment request before the programme's deadline, then complete the Osiris questionnaire, upload whatever diplomas you do hold and a blank PDF stating that you are applying via a full Colloquium Doctum. You then have to pass the VWO-level subjects Twente lists for this programme — VWO English and VWO Mathematics A, B or C — with certificates from CCVX, James Boswell or the Dutch Official State Examination, all before that programme's deadline. There is no blanket Dutch-language requirement: VWO Dutch appears in Twente's table only against its Dutch-taught programmes, and not against this one. Twente also publishes two slower routes: an hbo propedeuse, the first 60 ECTS of a bachelor at a Dutch university of applied sciences, NVAO-accredited and relevant to the programme, which it says does not guarantee admission; and a foundation year, accepted only where the resulting qualification is nationally accredited in the country it was taken in, assessed case by case. All of these wait for your 21st birthday. Retaking to be awarded the full IB Diploma is the route that reaches this at eighteen. One further route is national rather than this institution's, and it is the only one that produces the qualification itself instead of an exemption from it: the Dutch staatsexamen vwo. Anyone who registers may sit vwo subjects one at a time with DUO — registration for the 2027 examinations runs from 15 October to 31 December 2026, each subject costs 144 euro with a ceiling of 720 euro a year, and the certificates stay valid for ten years, so the package can be built up and exchanged for a vwo diploma at the end. No age limit applies, which is what makes it different from every colloquium doctum above, and Dutch law lets the College voor Toetsen en Examens grant you ontheffing from individual subjects on the strength of International Baccalaureate results — the one place in Dutch education law where the IB is named. The bill is linguistic: by statute the examinations are sat in Dutch.

requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you, and Twente publishes the alternative in more detail than any other Dutch institution here. Twente names IB certificates once, and only "in combination with another high school diploma", so Course Results standing alone are not directly admissible. What it publishes instead is the Colloquium Doctum (toelatingsonderzoek), which it runs under articles 7.25, 7.28 and 7.29 of the Dutch Higher Education Act. You must be at least 21 on 1 September of the year you start. Applications open on 1 October through Studielink like anybody else's: you file a normal enrolment request before the programme's deadline, then complete the Osiris questionnaire, upload whatever diplomas you do hold and a blank PDF stating that you are applying via a full Colloquium Doctum. You then have to pass the VWO-level subjects Twente lists for this programme — VWO English and VWO Mathematics B — with certificates from CCVX, James Boswell or the Dutch Official State Examination, all before that programme's deadline. There is no blanket Dutch-language requirement: VWO Dutch appears in Twente's table only against its Dutch-taught programmes, and not against this one. Twente also publishes two slower routes: an hbo propedeuse, the first 60 ECTS of a bachelor at a Dutch university of applied sciences, NVAO-accredited and relevant to the programme, which it says does not guarantee admission; and a foundation year, accepted only where the resulting qualification is nationally accredited in the country it was taken in, assessed case by case. All of these wait for your 21st birthday. Retaking to be awarded the full IB Diploma is the route that reaches this at eighteen. One further route is national rather than this institution's, and it is the only one that produces the qualification itself instead of an exemption from it: the Dutch staatsexamen vwo. Anyone who registers may sit vwo subjects one at a time with DUO — registration for the 2027 examinations runs from 15 October to 31 December 2026, each subject costs 144 euro with a ceiling of 720 euro a year, and the certificates stay valid for ten years, so the package can be built up and exchanged for a vwo diploma at the end. No age limit applies, which is what makes it different from every colloquium doctum above, and Dutch law lets the College voor Toetsen en Examens grant you ontheffing from individual subjects on the strength of International Baccalaureate results — the one place in Dutch education law where the IB is named. The bill is linguistic: by statute the examinations are sat in Dutch.

alternativeRouteSummary.short: From 21: Twente's colloquium doctum, with vwo-level subject certificates before the deadline. At 18, only the full Diploma reaches it.

requirements.note: Twente does not state this in IB terms and this record does not translate it. It asks for mathematics 'comparable to a pre-university level, such as VWO Wiskunde B', names Dutch and German qualifications as examples, names no IB course or level, and assesses the transcript you upload. It is deliberately NOT recorded as a local-equivalency requirement on the Dutch subject scale. That shape requires a Recognition Scheme defining the scale, and scripts/test-eligibility.mjs rightly fails a requirement naming a scale nothing defines. No such scheme exists for the Netherlands and none was written, because neither Twente nor Nuffic publishes what an IB mathematics course counts as in Dutch terms; writing one would mean inventing the table. So it is recorded as kind 'other' with the official wording intact, and this tool will tell you it cannot check it — which is the truth. Upload your transcript and ask Twente.

notes: Twente publishes each intake's admission requirements only from the October before it and says in terms that it cannot give information about a future intake. Everything on this record is the September 2026 rule and should be re-read after October 2026. It is marked needs-review for that reason rather than presented as settled.

Twente's own deadline for the 2026 intake was 30 April 23:59 CET, a day before the national one. The 2027 date was not published when this was checked. Work to 1 May 2027 as the outer limit and expect Twente to set something earlier.

The matching procedure is the Dutch studiekeuzecheck and Twente makes it compulsory here: "Matching is a mandatory step for starting Technical Computer Science. It consists of two required parts: An online questionnaire; A matching event. Both are mandatory for the procedure to be completed." It is recorded in admission.selection with weight 'none' because the requirement model has no place for a step that is compulsory and unscored — marking it mandatory would make the tool answer 'needs review' on a question that is not about eligibility, and marking it a Selection Factor would say it ranks you, which it does not.

Twente does not publish what IB mathematics counts as VWO Wiskunde B, so this Opportunity will assess as needing review for every student. That is the correct answer and not a data gap: the gap is in what Twente publishes, and it is recorded here rather than papered over.

If Twente judges your mathematics short, the route back is a CCVX, James Boswell-Bèta or Dutch Staatsexamen certificate taken before the application deadline. Twente names OMPT and Korteweg-de Vries tests as not accepted, which matters because Erasmus accepts OMPT — the remedial tests are not interchangeable between universities.
